generationMethod: Manual authoring from src/app/marea-design-system/core/i18n.ts (MAREA_COPY and MareaI18n), core/types.ts (MareaLocale, MareaLocalizedText), data/fixtures/marea-fixtures.generated.ts (localized summary fields) and the routing contract in docs/marea/information-architecture/MC15-MC16-HANDOFF.md. Key list counted from the source file; no generator writes this dataset.
scope: Bilingual presentation contract for the isolated MC-17 design system: copy-dictionary size, parity rule, localized fixture fields and the one-entity/two-locale identity rule.
knownLimitations: The copy is internal and provisional. No public MAREA copy is authorised and the dictionary is not an approved public translation.
Spanish public paths stay unprefixed and English paths stay under /en; this dataset records the contract but creates no route.
The internal catalogue shell, section headings and demonstration prose are Spanish-only; only component copy and the family summary fixture are bilingual.
No Arabic, RTL or additional locale is in scope. MareaLocale is exactly 'es' | 'en'.
The validator counts dictionary pairs structurally; it cannot judge semantic equivalence of a nuance, which remains a human review duty.

locales.documentLocaleMechanism: MareaTheme.ngOnChanges sets MareaI18n.locale before children render; the host binds [attr.lang] to the active locale.
locales.ssrHydrationNote: A single document locale is set by the theme host so server-rendered markup and hydration agree; components read copy from the dictionary synchronously.

routing.rule: One entity, one component, two locales. No locale-specific page, edition, bundle or SKU may be created.

copyDictionary.parityRule: Every key has exactly one non-empty ES string and one non-empty EN string; EN must express the same claim, never a weaker or stronger one.

localizedFixtureFields.renderedBy: not rendered: no authorized localized content exists

identityRules.slugIdentity: dynamic slugs use the same identifier in both locales; an edition id never appears in a URL
identityRules.evidence: scripts/check-marea-design-system.mjs MC17-26 asserts zero *.en.ts/*.es.ts component files and exactly 26 edition ids in fixtures.

ctaStates.es: Acción no disponible: la publicación comercial no está autorizada. No existe botón de compra.
ctaStates.en: Action unavailable: commercial publication is not authorised. No purchase button exists.

ctaStates.es: Concepto interno definido sin fecha aprobada. No hay preventa, reserva ni lista de espera.
ctaStates.en: Internal concept defined without an approved date. There is no pre-order, reservation or waiting list.

ctaStates.es: Información pendiente de autorización de copy. Esta vista interna no recoge datos personales ni crea un mecanismo de contacto.
ctaStates.en: Information pending copy authorisation. This internal view collects no personal data and creates no contact mechanism.

ctaStates.es: Categoría de interacción contractual futura. No constituye una oferta, no muestra precio y no garantiza un presupuesto.
ctaStates.en: Future contractual interaction category. It is not an offer, shows no price and does not guarantee a quotation.

ctaStates.es: No disponible. El estado refleja puertas de seguridad o legales cerradas.
ctaStates.en: Not available. The status reflects closed safety or legal gates.

familyLimits.es: Concepto de pilotaje asistido. Sin navegación autónoma ni control de gobierno en vivo. Puerta de seguridad bloqueada.
familyLimits.en: Supervised pilot concept. No autonomous navigation and no live steering control. Safety gate blocked.

familyLimits.es: Recepción únicamente. Sin transmisión AIS ni promesa de evitación de colisiones.
familyLimits.en: Receive-only. No AIS transmission and no collision-avoidance promise.

familyLimits.es: Los datos de cartas náuticas y meteorología no licenciados no se representan como incluidos.
familyLimits.en: Unlicensed chart and weather data are not represented as included.

familyLimits.es: Un kit que representa POWER + BILGE; los módulos no se cuentan dos veces.
familyLimits.en: One kit representing POWER + BILGE; modules are not double-counted.

familyLimits.es: No se garantizan alertas ni una monitorización remota continua.
familyLimits.en: Alerts are not guaranteed and continuous remote monitoring is not provided.

familyLimits.es: Sin hardware por defecto y sin acuerdo de nivel de servicio establecido.
familyLimits.en: No default hardware and no established service-level agreement.

familyLimits.es: Sin dimensiones, tamaño final ni precio inventados.
familyLimits.en: No invented dimensions, final size or price.

copyAuthorization.rule: No dictionary string may be presented as an approved public claim. Provisional status must accompany any rendered MAREA identity.

enforcement.check25Expectation: parsed bilingual keys equals declared keys; every ES and EN string non-empty
enforcement.check26Expectation: zero locale-suffixed component files; 26 unique edition ids
